headline.text: L3 holds *4,108 lbs* of chocolate plus three unlabeled pallets pending traceability resolution — production line awaits final label guidance.

summary: One active hold at L3 Truffle Line (chocolate traceability). Quality challenges continue at L2 ML3 (5–10 leakers per mold, air bubbles in caramel) and L3 ML4 (TG3 sealing—one tote of rework). L1 saw multiple sanitation gaps flagged during Plant Standards walk.

holds.title: Chocolate traceability hold — 4,108 lbs plus 3 pallets
holds.summary: Truffle Line production placed on hold due to chocolate lot traceability uncertainty; Preston and Fredy coordinating to resolve discrepancy before releasing pallets for final labeling.
holds.status: On hold pending traceability review — Preston indicated records show chocolate added July 15, needs reconciliation with current job before disposition.

food_safety.title: Broken parts found under ML4 Z conveyor
food_safety.summary: Two plastic parts discovered broken off Z conveyor during 3rd shift; Kimberly removed pieces and Chad requested vendor contact to order replacements.
food_safety.status: Resolved — broken pieces removed from production area; replacement parts being sourced.

food_safety.title: Tunnel cooling cover dropped during 3rd shift
food_safety.summary: Truffle Line operator dropped Tunnel 4 cover while lifting; cover placed on conveyor then moved to wooden pallet per Chad's instruction to avoid recontamination.
food_safety.status: Resolved — cover removed from food zone; conveyor cleaned; cover on pallet awaiting glue repair.

food_safety.title: Lost tools reported at MF Matrix
food_safety.summary: Operator posted image of lost tools; no further detail on recovery or line search provided in window.
food_safety.status: Open — no confirmation of tool recovery or completed line search.

quality.title: ML3 leakers persist — 5–10 per mold
quality.summary: Caramel-filled chocolates leaking due to air bubbles in caramel depositor; Erandy worked manual dump workaround on 2nd shift, but 1st shift still seeing same rate this morning.
quality.status: Open — manual caramel dump reduced leaks to <5/mold overnight, but issue returned 1st shift 06:24; Alan requesting additional changes from Alex/Erandy.

quality.title: ML4 TG3 sealing failures — one tote of rework
quality.summary: Theegarten 3 producing bad seals throughout 1st shift; tech Marco made repeated adjustments but continued running, accumulating one full tote of unwrapped bars for rework.
quality.status: Resolved — Ray confirmed fix (film centering) by 15:27; tote rewrapped overnight on alternate Theegarten machine per Marcos.

sanitation.title: S3 C2 conveyor failed post-cleaning inspection
sanitation.summary: Luis Falcon reported excessive caramel buildup on C2 conveyor requiring full reclean before startup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — conveyor recleaned; enrober declared ready 05:30.

sanitation.title: Plant Standards walk identifies multiple sanitation gaps
sanitation.summary: Kathleen and Jorel documented unlabeled buckets, food-contact buckets used for cleaning, dirty gaskets, improper glove storage, and mop buckets left uncleaned after use.
sanitation.status: Open — findings posted with photos; corrective actions assigned to Jody, Justin, Jorel, Brandon.

sanitation.title: ML1 roller buildup flagged during CIL
sanitation.summary: Frederick posted image of excessive chocolate buildup on rollers; Chad directed team to add roller cleaning to 2-hour inspection interval.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Raoul confirmed addition to shift report; new inspection frequency in place.

sanitation.title: Clean parts left uncovered at S3
sanitation.summary: Katya reminded Luis and Brandon to cover all clean parts until installation to prevent recontamination.
sanitation.status: Open — coaching delivered; no confirmation of immediate compliance.

sanitation.title: ML2 dirty molds swapped mid-run
sanitation.summary: Operators replaced 37 dirty molds with clean ones to improve chocolate appearance; swap completed during 2nd shift.
sanitation.status: Resolved — clean molds in place; no product held.

opportunities.text: Review color-coding and labeling protocol for sanitation tools and buckets — today's Plant Standards walk found white (food-contact) buckets used for cleaning and stored in non-food zones.
Consider pre-shift caramel viscosity or aeration check for ML3 — two consecutive days of air-bubble-driven leakers suggest upstream process variability not visible until deposition.

Consider adding cooling tunnel cover handling to ML4 and Truffle Line startup checklists — today's dropped cover at Truffle Line echoes a similar TG3 separator issue yesterday, both involving lifting procedures.
